description: List the Tables (rooms in the app where members sit together around fellowship, prayer, the Bible, a question or a testimony) open right now on The Living Bread: title, host first name, seats, how many are present, family members there, the Scripture reference, and its link. Requires sign-in: on the public endpoint it returns signed_in false, count 0 and the link, and lists nothing; on /me it reads the live hall as that believer. Use for "is anyone gathered right now". For public church events tonight use gatherings_tonight; for ongoing groups use communities_to_join. Each table carries freshness: verified_live only when someone was seen in the last two minutes. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.
name: tables_live_now

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

count.description: Tables listed; 0 when none is open or not signed in.

door.description: Link to the hall of Tables.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

signed_in.description: False on the public endpoint, where no tables are listed.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

tables.description: Each table: id, title, host first name, physics (its kind: fellowship, prayer, bible, question, debate, shepherd, testimony, open), seats, present now, family members present, Scripture reference, city, scheduled time, whether a seat is saved for the believer, and its link.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Tables open now
